title: CrystalForge
description: Forge your legend across dimensions with crystals of extraordinary power.
body:
**CrystalForge is a content expansion mod that enriches your Minecraft experience with 5 new mystical ores, each possessing unique characteristics and spawn locations.**

## **🌍 Overworld Ores**

**Azurite** (Y-levels -64 to 64) - The most common ore, perfect for starting out

**Crimsonite** (Y-levels -32 to 48) - A balanced ore with crimson hues

**Voidstone** (Y-levels -64 to -32) - Rare and powerful, hidden in the depths

## **🔥 Nether Ore**

Emberite (Y-levels 10 to 120) - Infused with the Nether's burning essence

## **✨ End Ore**

Celestium (Y-levels 20 to 80) - The ultimate ore with legendary capabilities

## **⚔️ Armor Tier Ranking (Best to Worst)**

**Celestium** - The supreme armor with exceptional bonuses

**Emberite** - Specialized for the Nether

**Voidstone** - Maximum defense and regeneration

**Crimsonite** - Balance between protection and power

**Azurite** - Versatile with night vision

Each ore allows you to create a complete arsenal: armor sets, standard tools (sword, pickaxe, axe, shovel, hoe), and the Hammer, a special tool capable of mining in a 3x3 area. Full armor sets grant unique set bonuses tailored to each material's playstyle.
